faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: Can I access the app while offline?
faq.answer1: Yes, you can access the app offline with limited features.
faq.question2: How do I reset my password?
faq.answer2: You can reset your password by going to the settings.
faq.answer3: You can sign up by clicking on the sign-up button.
faq.answer4: You can login by entering your username and password.
faq.question5: How do I report an accident?
faq.answer5: You can report an accident by clicking on the report button.
faq.question6: What information do I need to provide?
faq.answer6: You need to provide your name, contact details, and accident details.
faq.answer7: Yes, you can edit your report before submitting.
faq.answer8: We offer monthly and yearly subscription plans.
faq.question9: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer9: You can cancel your subscription by going to the subscription settings.
faq.question10: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.answer10: Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial.
